ui.notesText1: These demos show the outputs of NoShitUi-skill: resource research becomes a visual direction, a representative workflow, and a working interface. Discover resources, compare approaches, implement the design, and verify the result.
ui.notesText2: All twenty examples belong to this Skill showcase, from four 3D experiences to product workflows, creative tools, and brand pages. The resource atlas and shadcn dashboard are examples within the collection. Use the GitHub guide to install the Skill and apply its workflow to your own project.

object.name: OBJECT//
object.description: A Three.js lamp studio with CC0 glTF models, material choices, and brightness controls for a live 3D preview.

botanical.name: rooted.
botanical.description: Four sculpted plants to turn and explore, with warm ceramic pots, care guidance, filters, and a working shopping bag.

drift.name: DRIFT.
drift.description: Explore a Three.js coastal map with terrain, places, and routes, then collect stops in a saved itinerary.

mission.name: ORBITAL/
mission.description: A dense mission dashboard with telemetry, subsystem status, orbit visualization, and simulation controls.

tempo.name: TEMPO
tempo.slogan:
A good place
to press play.
tempo.description: An original listening room with three local tracks, a live waveform, a record collection, and a queue that follows the music.

frame.name: FRAME
frame.description: A hands-on poster studio. Choose a template, move the layers, find your words, and take home a real PNG or SVG.

stay.name: STAY
stay.description: A sun-soaked coastal retreat with room discovery, date and guest selection, a complete booking flow, and saved reservations.

node.name: NODE
node.slogan:
A little logic.
A lot of possibility.
node.description: Build a flow, connect the pieces, and watch a local simulation bring it to life. An editable canvas with parameters, validation, and a run log.

loop.name: LOOP
loop.description: A thoughtful learning space with three practical design lessons, quizzes with explanations, field notes, and progress that stays with you.

source.name: SOURCE
source.description: Explore a complete fictional API, search the docs, switch code examples, and try requests in an interactive local playground.

archive.name: ARCHIVE
archive.description: Five public-domain paintings to look at closely. Explore the periods, zoom into the details, and take home a personal exhibition guide.

plate.name: PLATE
plate.description: A neighborhood Italian kitchen with a menu to explore, dishes to make your own, a working bag, and a complete demonstration ordering flow.

precision.name: PRECISION_
precision.description: A calm operations workspace for records, filters, edits, and the small states that make a product trustworthy.

shadcn.name: SHADCN/OPS
shadcn.description: A shadcn/ui orders dashboard with search, status filters, and an edit dialog for session-based records.

atlas.name: Resource atlas
atlas.description: A resource discovery example for NoShitUi-skill: browse UI references, filter by category, save useful finds, and compare visual directions.

editorial.name: FORME
editorial.description: An architecture journal for considered living, with serif typography, image-led pacing, and focused reading.

studio.name: OFFGRID®
studio.description: A rebellious design studio built from posters, marquee type, acid color, and big gestures.

nova.name: NOVA//25
nova.description: A neon festival concept with an animated particle field, glowing signals, and an interactive ticket moment.

aether.name: AETHER
aether.description: An atmospheric visual experiment built from fluid color, orbiting light, and magnetic cursor interaction.

kinetic.name: KINETIC_
kinetic.description: A typographic playground where cursor trails, offset color, and a burst control make letters feel physical.
